name: rust-ai-lean
description: Spend fewer tokens on Rust: working rust-analyzer LSP, quiet cargo, outline/crate-src/diag tools, and a doctor that checks it all

args: if command -v rustup >/dev/null 2>&1; then ra=$(rustup which --toolchain stable rust-analyzer) || exit 1; else ra=$(command -v rust-analyzer) || exit 1; fi; exec "$ra"
